item.title: Feynman on Science, Religion, and Doubt
item.description: A reading of The Meaning of It All. Why scientists tend not to believe, what NOMA gets right, and where Feynman goes wrong on religion.

item.title: Intelligent Design Is Not Science: The Kitzmiller v. Dover Case
item.description: A close reading of one of the most significant court cases in American educational history — Kitzmiller v. Dover Area School District (2005). Science, creationism, and the First Amendment.
